scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo 'lefthook: hooks not installed (no git repository, or lefthook unavailable) — expected inside a Docker build'
scripts.fmt: oxfmt --write frontend backend shared scripts .github package.json lefthook.yml docker-compose.dev.yml docker-compose.prod.yml
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check frontend backend shared scripts .github package.json lefthook.yml docker-compose.dev.yml docker-compose.prod.yml
scripts.validate:compose: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config --quiet
